privacy.title: Your pictures stay with you
privacy.p1: The camera picture goes only to this phone or computer. Facemaker draws the funny face right here.
privacy.p2: Nothing is sent to the internet. There are no accounts and no tracking.
privacy.p3: A photo or a video leaves the device only when you tap share and pick a friend or an app.
privacy.p4: Photos and videos you take are kept on this device, in the app's own storage. Delete them in the gallery or in settings.

privacy.p5: The microphone is on only while you record a video, try a voice, or use the shout face. It turns off a few seconds later. The sound stays on this device.
voice.denied: Microphone is off. Allow it in the browser settings.
